AddSharesToExpressSync.description_en: Adds one or more shares to an express synchronization group
AddSharesToExpressSync.description_zh: 添加共享到极速同步组中，可以添加多个共享

CreateGateway.description_en: Creates a subscription or pay-as-you-go gateway
CreateGateway.description_zh: 创建一个包年包月或按量付费的网关

CreateGatewayBlockVolume.description_en: Creates a block volume (iSCSI) for an iSCSI gateway
CreateGatewayBlockVolume.description_zh: 在块网关下创建一个块卷（iSCSI）

CreateGatewayCacheDisk.description_en: Creates a cache disk for a gateway
CreateGatewayCacheDisk.description_zh: 在网关下创建一个缓存盘

CreateGatewayFileShare.description_en: Creates a file share for a file gateway
CreateGatewayFileShare.description_zh: 在文件网关下创建文件共享

CreateGatewayLogging.description_en: Enables log monitoring for a gateway

CreateGatewaySMBUser.description_en: Adds an SMB user to a file gateway
CreateGatewaySMBUser.description_zh: 在文件网关添加一个SMB用户

DeleteExpressSync.description_en: Deletes a specified express synchronization group

DeleteGateway.description_en: Deletes a pay-as-you-go gateway from its cluster
DeleteGateway.description_zh: 从所属集群上删除一个按量付费的网关

DeleteGatewayBlockVolumes.description_en: Deletes the specified iSCSI gateway block volumes
DeleteGatewayBlockVolumes.description_zh: 删除指定的块网关块卷

DeleteGatewayCacheDisk.description_en: Deletes a cache disk from a file gateway
DeleteGatewayCacheDisk.description_zh: 在文件网关下删除缓存盘

DeleteGatewayFileShares.description_en: Deletes one or more file shares from a file gateway
DeleteGatewayFileShares.description_zh: 删除指定文件网关中的指定文件共享

DeleteGatewayLogging.description_en: Deletes the log monitoring feature for a gateway

DeleteGatewaySMBUser.description_en: Deletes a specified Server Message Block (SMB) user from a file gateway
DeleteGatewaySMBUser.description_zh: 删除文件网关中指定的SMB用户

DeleteStorageBundle.description_en: If the gateway cluster contains online or on-premises Cloud Storage Gateways, you must delete all gateways before you can delete the cluster
DeleteStorageBundle.description_zh: 如果网关集群存在线上或线下云存储网关，请删除所有网关以后再删除该网关集群

DeployGateway.description_en: You can call the DeployGateway operation to deploy a pay-as-you-go gateway
DeployGateway.description_zh: 调用DeployGateway接口可以部署一个按量付费的网关

DescribeAccountConfig.description_en: Retrieves the configuration of an account

DescribeExpressSyncShares.description_en: Queries for shares that are associated with an express synchronization group or can be added to the group. The returned information includes details such as the gateway name, cluster ID, and share name
DescribeExpressSyncShares.description_zh: 查询极速同步组对应的共享信息或可加入极速同步组的共享信息。包括极速同步组对应共享的网关名称、集群ID、共享名称等详情

DescribeExpressSyncs.description_en: Queries the details of express synchronization groups, including their names, IDs, and bucket names
DescribeExpressSyncs.description_zh: 查询极速同步组，包括极速同步组名称、极速同步组ID、Bucket名称等详情

DescribeGateway.description_en: Queries basic information about a gateway, such as its status and type, based on the specified gateway ID
DescribeGateway.description_zh: 根据指定网关ID查询网关的基本信息。包括网关状态、类型等详情

DescribeGatewayADInfo.description_en: Queries information about the AD server configured for a gateway
DescribeGatewayADInfo.description_zh: 获取网关上配置的AD服务器信息

DescribeGatewayBlockVolumes.description_en: Queries details about iSCSI gateway volumes, such as operation status, data transfer, address, capacity, port, CHAP, OSS Bucket SSL, LUN ID, and volume status
DescribeGatewayBlockVolumes.description_zh: 查询块网关卷详情，例如：操作状态、传输数据、地址、容量、端口、CHAP、OSS Bucket SSL、LUN ID、卷状态

DescribeGatewayCaches.description_en: Queries information about cache disks, such as size and type
DescribeGatewayCaches.description_zh: 查询缓存盘信息，包括缓存盘大小、类型等

DescribeGatewayClasses.description_zh: 调用DescribeGatewayClasses可查询网关的所有可用规格

DescribeGatewayDNS.description_en: You can call the DescribeGatewayDNS operation to query the DNS servers that are configured on a gateway
DescribeGatewayDNS.description_zh: 调用DescribeGatewayDNS获取网关上配置的DNS服务器信息

DescribeGatewayFileShares.description_en: Describes the configurations of file shares on a file gateway
DescribeGatewayFileShares.description_zh: 获取文件网关上共享的配置信息

DescribeGatewayFileStatus.description_en: Queries the status of a single file in a file gateway's file share
DescribeGatewayFileStatus.description_zh: 查询文件网关某个共享下单个文件的状态

DescribeGatewayImages.description_en: Queries details of on-premises gateway images, including their names and descriptions
DescribeGatewayImages.description_zh: 查询线下网关镜像信息。包括线下网关镜像的名称、描述等

DescribeGatewayLocations.description_en: Returns a list of gateway locations

DescribeGatewayLogging.description_en: Queries the logging configurations of a gateway, including the logging status, Simple Log Service (SLS) project name, and Logstore name
DescribeGatewayLogging.description_zh: 查询网关日志监控，包括日志监控的状态及日志项目(Project)名称和日志库(Logstore)

DescribeGatewayModificationClasses.description_en: Queries the instance types to which a gateway can be upgraded
DescribeGatewayModificationClasses.description_zh: 调用DescribeGatewayModificationClasses接口可查询线上网关的可升配规格信息

DescribeGatewayNFSClients.description_en: Queries the NFS clients for a file gateway
DescribeGatewayNFSClients.description_zh: 查询文件网关中NFS挂载客户端列表

DescribeGatewaySMBClients.description_en: Queries the Server Message Block (SMB) clients of a file gateway
DescribeGatewaySMBClients.description_zh: 查询文件网关中SMB挂载客户端列表

DescribeGatewaySMBSecurityStrategy.description_en: Queries the Server Message Block (SMB) security level configuration of a gateway
DescribeGatewaySMBSecurityStrategy.description_zh: 查询网关SMB安全级别配置

DescribeGatewaySMBUsers.description_en: Queries the list of SMB usernames on a file gateway
DescribeGatewaySMBUsers.description_zh: 获取文件网关上SMB用户名列表

DescribeGatewayTypes.description_en: Queries the available gateway types for a specified location
DescribeGatewayTypes.description_zh: 根据网关位置，查询网关可用类型

DescribeGateways.description_en: Queries a list of gateways and returns their IDs and names
DescribeGateways.description_zh: 查询网关列表信息。包括网关ID，网关名称等

DescribeRegions.description_en: You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the valid regions for gateways
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 调用DescribeRegions可以查询网关有效的地域信息

DescribeStorageBundle.description_en: Queries information about a gateway cluster, including its region, timestamp, name, and description
DescribeStorageBundle.description_zh: 查询网关集群信息。包括所在地域、时间戳、名称和描述等

DescribeStorageBundles.description_en: Queries information about storage bundles, including their names, descriptions, and creation time
DescribeStorageBundles.description_zh: 查询集群列表信息。包括网关集群名称、描述及创建时间等

DescribeTasks.description_en: Queries task information, including task progress and name
DescribeTasks.description_zh: 查询指定任务对应的信息。包括任务的进度和任务名称等

DisableGatewayLogging.description_en: Disables the log monitoring feature for a gateway

EnableGatewayLogging.description_en: Enables log monitoring for a gateway

ExpandCacheDisk.description_en: Expands the cache disk of a Cloud Storage Gateway

ExpandGatewayFileShare.description_en: Increases the capacity of a share for an on-premises gateway
ExpandGatewayFileShare.description_zh: 线下网关扩容文件共享

ExpandGatewayNetworkBandwidth.description_en: Expands the public bandwidth of a gateway
ExpandGatewayNetworkBandwidth.description_zh: 扩容网关数据公网带宽

ListAlertEvents.description_en: Lists alert events for a gateway

ListTagResources.description_en: Lists the tags attached to one or more gateways
ListTagResources.description_zh: 查询一个或多个网关已经绑定的标签列表

ModifyGateway.description_en: Modifies a specified gateway's basic information, including its name and description
ModifyGateway.description_zh: 对指定网关的基本信息进行修改。包括网关的名称和描述

ModifyGatewayClass.description_en: Upgrades the gateway class of an online gateway
ModifyGatewayClass.description_zh: 可对线上网关的网关规格进行升配

ModifyGatewayFileShareWatermark.description_en: Modifies the watermark for a gateway file share
ModifyGatewayFileShareWatermark.description_zh: 调整网关文件共享淘汰水位

ModifyStorageBundle.description_en: Modifies the basic information of a specified gateway cluster, such as its name and description
ModifyStorageBundle.description_zh: 对指定网关集群的基本信息进行修改，包括网关集群名称、描述

OpenSgwService.description_en: Activates the gateway service. The service must be activated before you can use the product
OpenSgwService.description_zh: 开通网关服务。只有开通服务后，才能进行产品使用

RemoveSharesFromExpressSync.description_en: You can call the RemoveSharesFromExpressSync operation to delete multiple shares from an express synchronization group
RemoveSharesFromExpressSync.description_zh: 调用RemoveSharesFromExpressSync可以删除极速同步组对应的共享。可删除多个共享

RestartFileShares.description_en: Restarts file shares on a Cloud Storage Gateway
RestartFileShares.description_zh: 调用RestartFileShares可以重启云存储网关上的文件共享

SetGatewayADInfo.description_en: Sets or purges the AD server information for a gateway
SetGatewayADInfo.description_zh: 为网关设置或清除AD服务器信息

SetGatewayDNS.description_en: Adds DNS server information to a file gateway
SetGatewayDNS.description_zh: 向文件网关添加NDS服务器信息

SetGatewaySMBSecurityStrategy.description_en: Sets the Server Message Block (SMB) security level for a gateway

TagResources.description_en: Creates tags and attaches the tags to resources
TagResources.description_zh: 为指定的网关创建并绑定标签

TriggerGatewayRemoteSync.description_en: Actively triggers a file gateway to perform a reverse synchronization on the specified path
TriggerGatewayRemoteSync.description_zh: 主动触发文件网关对指定路径进行一次反向同步

UntagResources.description_en: Detaches tags from a specified gateway
UntagResources.description_zh: 为指定的网关解绑标签

UpdateGatewayBlockVolume.description_en: Updates the configuration of a block volume on an iSCSI gateway
UpdateGatewayBlockVolume.description_zh: 在块网关下更新块卷配置

UpdateGatewayFileShare.description_en: This operation updates the configuration of a file share for a file gateway
UpdateGatewayFileShare.description_zh: 在文件网关下更新文件共享配置

UpgradeGateway.description_zh: 根据网关ID对指定的网关进行升级

UploadGatewayLog.description_zh: 调用UploadGatewayLog上传网关支持信息
